name: Required Checks

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - name: Run lints
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings

  build:
    needs: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - name: Build project
        run: cargo build --release

  vm:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - name: Test VM
        run: cargo test --package vm

  cli:
    needs: vm
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - name: Test CLI
        run: cargo test --package cli

  primitives:
    needs: cli
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - name: Test Primitives
        run: cargo test --package primitives

  sdk:
    needs: primitives
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - name: Test SDK
        run: cargo test --package sdk

  recursion:
    needs: sdk
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - name: Test Recursion
        run: cargo test --package recursion

  extension-tests:
    needs: recursion
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - name: Test Extensions
        run: cargo test --package extension-tests

  riscv:
    needs: extension-tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - name: Test RISC-V
        run: cargo test --package riscv

  guest-lib-tests:
    needs: riscv
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - name: Test Guest Library
        run: cargo test --package guest-lib-tests

  benchmarks:
    needs: guest-lib-tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - name: Run Benchmarks
        run: cargo bench --package benchmarks

  benchmarks-execute:
    needs: benchmarks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - name: Execute Benchmarks
        run: cargo run --package benchmarks-execute

  docs:
    needs: benchmarks-execute
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - name: Generate Docs
        run: cargo doc --document-private-items

  native-compiler:
    needs: docs
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - name: Compile Native Code
        run: cargo build --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --release

merge-queue:
  needs: [lint, build, vm, cli, primitives, sdk, recursion, extension-tests, riscv, guest-lib-tests, benchmarks, benchmarks-execute, docs, native-compiler]
  runs-on: ubuntu-latest
  steps:
    - name: Check merge group status
      id: merge-group-status
      uses: peter-evans/enable-pull-request-automerge@v3
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        repository: openvm-org/openvm
        pull-request-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        merge-method: squash
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && github.event.action == 'opened'

    - name: Re-run workflows if necessary
      if: steps.merge-group-status.outputs.failure == 'true'
      run: echo "Re-running workflows due to failed merge group checks"
      # Additional steps to re-run workflows can be added here

    - name: Automerge if all checks pass
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && github.event.action == 'opened' && steps.merge-group-status.outputs.success == 'true'
      run: echo "All checks passed, automerging PR"
      # Additional steps to automate merge can be added here
